notes: A177431_iff: for b with b1=1,b2=3,b4=5 and exp(sum b^2 x^n/n) integral, for all integer m: exp(sum b^m x^n/n) integral iff m>=0 even. Even: Gauss congruences closed under powers (LGp_pow). Odd: 4 | 5^m-3^m fails (Gauss at p=2,a=2). Negative: x^2 coefficient (1+3^m)/2. Grouped with OEIS-A177430; main dir OEIS/A177430. Outside Lean: b(1),b(2),b(4)=1,3,5 from the greedy definition (certificate/greedy.py).

prior_art.note: Immediate from Dwork/Gauss congruences; no written proof found.
